de_benchmark.notes: THIS IS THE INPUT THE FROZEN THESIS RESULTS WERE PRODUCED FROM. The tags v1.0-results and v1.1-ood ship NO benchmark data -- only data/raw/.gitkeep -- so a checkout of either tag CANNOT reproduce the reported numbers on its own. Anyone reproducing from a tag must bring this file with them. v1.1-ood additionally ships live_ood_de.csv, but still needs THIS file for the benchmark reference. Verified 2026-08-29: a fresh download from the epftoolbox server was byte-identical to this copy, so upstream had not drifted as of that date.
